value_stream.name: Blueprint, Reprographics & Large-Format Plan Printing Services

fields.Owner: Reprographics Counter Associate / Store Services Lead
fields.Participants: Counter Associate, Trade Pro/Account (VS-43), Customer Service (VS-13), Legal (attestation — W5087)
fields.Trigger: Customer job submission (counter or portal W5086)

workflows.name: Customer Print-Job Intake, File Check, Quotation & Order Confirmation

Automation Opportunity: - Portal auto-pre-flight & quoting (W5086); attestation e-capture; quote→order auto-flow
Controls: - CTL-759 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Reprographics Job Lifecycle (PA-176.2).)
- CTL-759: attestation captured (W5087); pre-flight before quote; tariff-based pricing (W5083)
Cross-references: - links to VS-13 (CRM), VS-16 (O2C), VS-43 (trade pro); W5083 (pricing), W5086 (portal), W5087 (IP), W5090 (production), W5096 (billing)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Bad-file risk**: Corrupt/unsupported file → failed/late job; mitigated by pre-flight check
- **Mis-quote risk**: Quote below cost (W5083); mitigated by tariff-based quoting
- **IP risk**: Reproducing infringing material; mitigated by attestation (W5087)
System Touchpoints: - Print-management/job system (W5086); pricing/tariff (W5083); O2C/prepaid (W5096/VS-16); attestation (W5087); CRM (VS-13)

steps.activity: Intake & capture: receive the file (counter upload or portal W5086), capture job specs (size/media/color/copies/finishing/binding), and capture the customer authorship/IP attestation (W5087)
File check & pre-flight: validate format (PDF/DWG/DXF), pre-flight (scale/size/color), detect corruption, and confirm printability before quoting
Quote & confirm: auto/assisted quote per tariff (W5083), confirm with customer, take deposit/prepaid/credit (W5096), and release to production (W5090)

fields.Participants: Operator, Counter Associate, Quality check, Metrology (VS-115)

workflows.name: Large-Format Plan Printing, Plotting & Print-Quality Control

Automation Opportunity: - Plotter status/ink-level monitoring; auto-defect detection; consumables auto-deduct per job
Controls: - CTL-759: QC before finishing (W5097); calibration current (VS-115/W5088); consumables logged (W5099)
Cross-references: - links to VS-115 (calibration); W5084 (consumables), W5088 (maintenance), W5092 (finishing), W5097 (quality), W5099 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Defect risk**: Banding/bleed/scale error → rework/waste; mitigated by QC + calibration (VS-115/W5088)
- **Media/ink-fault risk**: Mid-run fault → delay; mitigated by monitoring + safety stock (W5084)
- **Consumables-tracking risk**: Untracked consumption → cost illusion; mitigated by per-job logging (W5099)
System Touchpoints: - Print-management/job system; plotter; consumables inventory (W5084); quality/dimensional check (W5097); analytics (W5099)

steps.activity: Set up & print: load media/ink (W5084), set print parameters (scale/DPI/color/profile), send to plotter, and monitor the run for media/ink faults
Quality-control: inspect output (scale accuracy W5097, color, line definition, no banding/bleed), and re-print defects before finishing (W5092)
Log & handoff: log consumables consumed (W5084/W5099), record job completion, and route to finishing/pickup (W5092/W5094)

fields.Participants: Operator, Counter Associate, IT (file delivery — VS-27), Privacy (VS-91)

workflows.name: Document Scanning, Archiving & Large-Format Digitization Service

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-DPI/color profile; OCR; secure-transfer automation; retention auto-policy (W5100)
Controls: - CTL-759 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Reprographics Job Lifecycle (PA-176.2).)
- CTL-759: consent captured (VS-91); QA before delivery; secure delivery/disposal (W5100); chain-of-custody
Cross-references: - links to VS-27 (IT), VS-91 (privacy); W5086 (portal), W5089 (intake), W5093 (archive), W5100 (disposal)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Legibility risk**: Low-quality scan unusable; mitigated by QA + DPI standard
- **Data-privacy risk**: Sensitive scanned docs (RA 10173); mitigated by consent + secure delivery/disposal (W5100)
- **Original-loss risk**: Customer original lost/damaged in scanning; mitigated by handling SOP + chain-of-custody
System Touchpoints: - Scanner; print-management/scan system (W5086); secure file delivery (VS-27); privacy/retention (VS-91/W5100); archive (W5093)

steps.activity: Intake & prepare: receive physical documents, condition check, capture scan specs (DPI/color/format), and the attestation/consent (W5087/RA 10173)
Scan & QA: large-format scan, inspect output (resolution/completeness/legibility), OCR where requested, and re-scan defects
Deliver & retain: deliver digital file (secure transfer W5086), archive per retention (W5093/W5100), and return/secure-dispose originals per customer instruction (W5100)

workflows.name: Plan Copying, Binding, Folding & Reproduction Service

Automation Opportunity: - Finishing-equipment integration; collation auto-QC; consumables auto-deduct
Controls: - CTL-759 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Reprographics Job Lifecycle (PA-176.2).)
- CTL-759: set collation verified; finish QA; consumables logged (W5099)
Cross-references: - links to W5084 (consumables), W5089 (intake), W5090 (printing), W5094 (pickup), W5099 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Set-error risk**: Miscollated/missing pages in multi-set; mitigated by collation QA
- **Finish-defect risk**: Poor binding/folding → unusable; mitigated by finish QA
- **Waste risk**: Excess copies/consumables; mitigated by exact-count control

steps.activity: Set up reproduction: copy-count, set collation, binding (staple/spiral/ velo), folding (engineering/half/roll) spec, and media (W5084)
Reproduce & finish: run copies, collate sets, bind, fold, and QA the finished set (completeness/order/finish quality)
Log & route: log job completion & consumables (W5099), and route to pickup/delivery (W5094)

fields.Participants: IT (VS-27), Privacy (VS-91), Counter Associate, Trade Pro/Account (VS-43)
fields.Volume: ~1,500–2,500 enrolled trade/B2B accounts (subset of ~5,200 trade accounts)

workflows.name: Customer File Storage, Reprint-on-Demand & Version Control Service

Automation Opportunity: - Retention auto-purge (W5100); version-tracking automation; reprint-on-demand self-service
Controls: - CTL-759: consent captured (VS-91); retention enforced (W5100); encryption/access control (VS-27); version integrity
Cross-references: - links to VS-27 (IT), VS-91 (privacy), VS-107 (account); W5086 (portal), W5090 (printing), W5096 (billing), W5100 (retention)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Retention-violation risk**: Holding files beyond consent/retention (RA 10173); mitigated by retention policy (W5100)
- **Version-confusion risk**: Customer reprints superseded version; mitigated by version control + notification
- **Security risk**: Stored files breached; mitigated by encryption + access control (VS-27)
System Touchpoints: - File storage/print-management (W5086); IT security (VS-27); privacy/retention (VS-91/W5100); CRM/account (VS-13/VS-107); O2C (W5096)

steps.activity: Enroll & store: capture consent for file storage (RA 10173), store the master file/versioned set securely, and set retention per policy (W5100)
Manage versions: version control (revision tracking), update-on-resubmit, and notify the customer of superseded versions
Reprint-on-demand: customer requests reprint from stored master → fast re-run (W5090) without re-intake, charge per tariff (W5083/W5096)

fields.Participants: Counter Associate, Customer Service (VS-13), Logistics/3PL (VS-06/VS-56), Store Services Lead

workflows.name: Customer Job Notification, Pickup, Delivery & Will-Call Management

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-ready notification; will-call retention auto-reminder; POD tracking
Controls: - CTL-759 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Reprographics Job Lifecycle (PA-176.2).)
- CTL-759: ID/signature release confirmation; will-call retention enforced; sensitive-doc secure delivery (W5100)
Cross-references: - links to VS-13 (CX), VS-75 (digital), VS-06/VS-56 (delivery); W5089 (intake), W5100 (confidentiality)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Abandoned-job risk**: Customer not picking up → will-call clutter & cost; mitigated by notification + will-call retention policy
- **Wrong-release risk**: Job released to wrong person; mitigated by ID/signature confirmation
- **Sensitive-delivery risk**: Secure document compromised in transit; mitigated by secure courier/chain-of-custody
System Touchpoints: - Notification (VS-75/VS-13); will-call/pickup; logistics/3PL (VS-06/VS-56); POD; secure delivery (W5100)

steps.activity: Notify ready: alert the customer (SMS/email/app — VS-75) on job completion, confirm pickup vs delivery, and stage for will-call/pickup
Pickup/will-call: customer pickup with ID/release confirmation, or will-call storage with retention, and capture signature
Delivery: arrange courier/3PL delivery (VS-06/VS-56), track POD, and handle sensitive-document secure delivery (W5087/W5100)

Automation Opportunity: - Bid-set template; multi-set auto-collation; account analytics dashboard
Controls: - CTL-759 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Reprographics Job Lifecycle (PA-176.2).)
- CTL-759: sealed-bid protocol (RA 9184); scope verified; deadline capacity (W5103); account billing reconciled (W5096)
Cross-references: - links to VS-107/VS-11/VS-46 (B2B/gov), VS-06 (logistics), VS-22 (compliance); W5090 (printing), W5092 (finishing), W5096 (billing), W5103 (capacity)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Deadline-miss risk**: Late bid-set → customer loses bid; mitigated by deadline-driven capacity (W5103)
- **Confidentiality risk**: Bid-set leak (RA 9184 sealed bid); mitigated by sealed-bid protocol (W5087)
- **Volume-error risk**: Wrong set/copy-count; mitigated by scope QA
System Touchpoints: - Print-management bulk module; CRM/account (VS-107/VS-11/VS-46); O2C (W5096/VS-16); logistics (VS-06); sealed-bid protocol (W5087)

steps.activity: Scope the bulk/bid-set: drawing set composition, copy-count per bidder/distribution, binding/folding, deadline, and sealed-bid/RA 9184 handling (W5087)
steps.r: Account Mgr / Trade Pro / Store Services Lead

steps.activity: Reproduce & distribute: high-volume multi-set reproduction (W5090/W5092), plan-room archiving (W5093), and distribution to bidders/sites
Bill & report: bulk/bid-set billing on account terms (W5096), sealed-bid confidentiality attestation, and account analytics (VS-107)

workflows.name: Customer Job Billing, Prepaid Account & Credit-Term Management

Automation Opportunity: - Prepaid auto-deduction; account-statement automation; margin/revenue analytics
Controls: - CTL-759 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Reprographics Job Lifecycle (PA-176.2).)
- CTL-759: tariff-based billing (W5083); prepaid-float GL-reconciled (VS-17); credit-term controls (VS-68); VAT correct (VS-79)
Cross-references: - links to VS-16 (O2C), VS-80 (payments), VS-68 (trade credit), VS-17/VS-17.4 (R2R/FP&A), VS-79 (tax); W5083 (pricing), W5099 (margin analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Prepaid-float risk**: Prepaid balance mis-managed → GL mismatch; mitigated by reconciliation (VS-17)
- **Credit/AR risk**: Credit-term non-payment; mitigated by trade-credit controls (VS-68)
- **Billing-error risk**: Mis-billed job → complaint; mitigated by tariff-based billing (W5083)
System Touchpoints: - O2C/AR (VS-16); POS/payments (VS-08/VS-80); prepaid module; trade credit (VS-68); GL/R2R (VS-17); FP&A (VS-17.4); tax (VS-79)

steps.activity: Bill the job: per-tariff billing (W5083), prepaid-account deduction or credit-term/cash/card (VS-80), and tax (VAT — VS-79)
Manage prepaid/credit accounts: prepaid top-up/float (trade-pro/B2B), credit-term setup/limit (VS-68), and account statement
Reconcile & report: job-revenue reconciliation, prepaid-float GL (VS-17), margin analytics (W5099), and FP&A (VS-17.4)
